text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's occasional display of 
astonishing perceptive ability still 
remained a complete mystery...

That being said, however, we must ensure 
she gains daily experience. And not just 
through "entering races"...
choice_data_list:
Universe, shall we go watch the Kikuka 
Sho?

text_block_list.text:
"Having them watch the race" is an 
important job too. If they're going to 
watch, I wanted them to have fun cheering 
in person at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho... The final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's a way of wrapping up things as a 
"senior," isn't it...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure you'll learn a lot from it!

Yeah, because it'll definitely be a great 
learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe says: 'Thank you.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Very "GENY"... Her eyes are filled with 
"mercy"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “—I feel it. This... kindness is...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."Known"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Someday... you will...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Not yet... "LYBL"...

And so, we headed to Kyoto Racecourse. And 
there—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Uni-san! Trainer-san! You came.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Look! All of this year's heroes, who have 
etched their names across countless 
battlefields, are gathered here!

Zenno Rob Roy was gazing intently toward 
the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"First and foremost, all eyes are on the 
race favorite... Horse number 6, of 
course. She is a Satsuki Sho Umamusume, 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Lining up alongside is Umamusume number 
18. And the rest is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho Umamusume... That... 
individual is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: We might... not be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I can't win? Are you saying the 
distance is too long?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Distance... Even before that, there's a 
massive barrier...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――"Launch Failure."
"Launch Failure." What could that mean?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This race is engulfed in a "magnetic 
storm." From this "unnavigable" void, the 
one who breaks through is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Umâan Umamusume.

With those words, what Neo Universe 
pointed at was...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I'm so nervous~. After all, this is 
my very first GⅠ~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
H-Heeey! I'm Hishi Miracle~ Never heard of 
me? Yeah, of course you haven't...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's introduce myself... Wait, there's 
nothing special to mention."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess you could say my selling 
point is being more average than anyone 
else~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh... Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was on a 9-race losing streak 
since my debut, and in my last race—which 
was my very first graded stakes race—I 
couldn't keep up at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, gotta live up to what people 
expect, right? Heheh...”

—Hishi Miracle. Her public reputation 
is... a totally average Umamusume.

"Her odds in this race were so long that 
even making the board would be considered 
a miracle."

"Could that Umamusume really win? In the 
Kikuka Sho, of all races...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, don't tell me...

I wanted to say it was impossible. No, 
anything can happen in a race. And yet...

――There's no way to know in advance. If 
Neo Universe were just an ordinary horse 
girl who happened to be a little 
eccentric, that is.

And so, the curtain rose on the decisive 
battle. Immediately following that—
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The Satsuki Sho Umamusume runs into 
unexpected trouble right after the start!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With that competitor pulled up, the race 
turns into total chaos! And breaking out 
before the finish line is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh, yaaay~~~! I'm the Kikuka Sho 
Umamusume! Whoaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm so exhausted~... *pant* 
*pant*... Everything's spinning~. Someone, 
water please~.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! It's Hishi Miracle! An 
unbelievable surge from the 10th favorite! 
She pulls off a miraculous victory!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...!? Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle-san actually won... And on 
top of that, the Satsuki Sho Umamusume had 
trouble right after the race...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san... you are...

There was no longer any room for doubt. 
Neo Universe was—

With her extraordinary intellect, perhaps 
she can deduce the future just from the 
visible information.

Even if it's not psychic powers, if she 
can really do something like that...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――"Known."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――"Known." This vision is... "ANOI"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "You"... are...

After saying that, Neo Universe falls 
silent.

"A piercing intellect and keen insight... 
It was at the Kikuka Sho that I witnessed 
just how terrifying that truly was."
